# FDG8067

> DO override `Equals` on value types.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.9.1.1 Equals on Value Types.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1815
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test suggestion
- Status: verified

CA1815 reports an externally visible struct that does not override Equals; it also reports a struct without the equality operators, which FDG8105 asks for. In a probe with SDK 10.0.402 it did not report a struct without fields, an enumerator struct or an internal struct, so coverage is partial; a struct with only const fields is reported (noise samples). The SDK code fix adds Equals and GetHashCode overrides that throw NotImplementedException (probe), so autofix is no. A suggestion: CA1815 also reports the missing equality operators, which FDG8105 asks for only if equality is meaningful; in the noise samples it gave that report to a struct with only const fields, whose values are all equal (1 false positive of 2), and it cannot be narrowed to its Equals message. FDG8053 (warning) reports structs with an instance field that do not implement IEquatable<T>.

## From the book

The default implementation uses reflection to access and compare all the fields. In consequence, it is often unacceptably inefficient.
